full_judgment: Shahabuddin Ahmed J: -The question raised in this appeal by special leave is whether the transfer in favour of Co-sharers whose interest has accrued by inheritance from their father, who had become a co-sharer in the holding by purchase, is protected from pre-emption under sub-section (10)(a) of Section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act 1950.
